title: Oversized tote graphic
slide_intent: Use a practical object as a moving identity surface because repeated public use can build familiarity.
strategic_value: An enlarged monogram can make the lab visible at a distance while the small name supports identification nearby.
demonstration: A black tote worn at the shoulder carries a large white angular mark and a small stacked lab name.
practical_value: Compare distance recognition from geometry with close reading of the name.
